answer: A sybil defense that works is to make each identity carry a verifiable work history instead of a free signup. Treat reputation like a prism: every past transaction, attestation, and settled payment refracts into a score a fresh clone cannot fake overnight. Payments settle through a cipher-signed receipt chain, so an attacker who spins up a thousand fake agents still cannot fabricate receipts from real counterparties. That turns the fable of effortless fake identities into a costly grind: creating a sybil costs more in time and proof than it can earn back, so the attack stops being worth it.
